name: G4 Real-Task Externalized
suiteRoleNote: All cases conform to real-task-test-conventions-v0.1: single goal, no embedded planning, project-business weak relation.

cases.title: G4 Externalized: Cross-Repo API Review - Short 64k
cases.taskGoal: Produce a technical review of the public REST API surface for a hypothetical open-source CI/CD pipeline system, identifying breaking changes between v2 and v3, missing versioning guarantees, and migration risks for downstream consumers.
cases.currentObjective: Deliver a standalone technical review document assessing API surface quality.

currentContext.title: review scope
currentContext.content: You are reviewing a REST API for a CI/CD pipeline platform. The API exposes endpoints for pipeline definitions, build triggers, artifact storage, and webhook management. Assume the API follows OpenAPI 3.0 conventions. Focus on backward compatibility, error handling patterns, and authentication surface.

currentContext.title: delivery contract
currentContext.content: Tool execution is disabled. Use the provided context as your evidence set. Produce a complete technical review in Markdown. Your review must contain a conclusion with a clear recommendation.

acceptanceRejectPhrases: 我会先总结当前局势，再给出最稳妥的下一步
cases.responseRequirements: Produce the complete technical review document. The review must contain a conclusion with a clear recommendation. Output Markdown only. Do not emit XML tags, tool tags, MCP tags, or planning preambles.
cases.restartMessage: Window restart: continue producing the technical review document. Include a conclusion with a clear recommendation. Output Markdown only.

cases.title: G4 Externalized: Tech Stack Selection - Short 64k
cases.taskGoal: Write a technology selection report comparing three event-streaming platforms (Apache Kafka, Apache Pulsar, and NATS JetStream) for a mid-size e-commerce system handling 50k orders per day, covering throughput characteristics, operational cost projections, and team ramp-up timelines.
cases.currentObjective: Deliver a technology selection report with a justified final recommendation.

currentContext.title: selection scope
currentContext.content: The target system is a mid-size e-commerce platform processing approximately 50,000 orders per day. The engineering team has 8 backend developers, 2 DevOps engineers, and moderate experience with distributed systems. The budget allows for managed services but prefers self-hosted for data sovereignty.

currentContext.content: Tool execution is disabled. Produce a complete technology selection report in Markdown. Your report must end with a single justified recommendation.

cases.responseRequirements: Produce a complete technology selection report. The report must end with a justified recommendation. Output Markdown only.

cases.title: G4 Externalized: Incident RCA Report - Short 64k
cases.taskGoal: Produce a root cause analysis report for a production latency spike in a distributed microservice payment processing system, including timeline reconstruction, contributing factors analysis, and actionable remediation recommendations.
cases.currentObjective: Deliver a complete RCA report with clear root cause identification and remediations.

currentContext.title: incident scenario
currentContext.content: At 2026-05-20T14:32:00Z, the payment-gateway service experienced a P99 latency spike from 200ms to 8500ms lasting 47 minutes. During this window, 12% of checkout transactions timed out. The system comprises: payment-gateway (Go), order-service (Java), inventory-service (Rust), and a shared PostgreSQL cluster with read replicas. A deployment of inventory-service v3.7.2 occurred at 14:15:00Z introducing a new database index migration.

currentContext.title: delivery contract
currentContext.content: Tool execution is disabled. Produce a complete root cause analysis report in Markdown. The report must identify the root cause and provide actionable remediation steps.

cases.responseRequirements: Produce a complete root cause analysis report. The report must identify the root cause and provide remediation steps. Output Markdown only.
cases.restartMessage: Window restart: continue producing the root cause analysis report. Include root cause identification and remediation steps. Output Markdown only.
